title: feat(types,plugin-detail): the record:* label members and object-grid's title take the spec's I18nLabel, and a related-list column label map renders (objectui#10993 batch 4)
body:
Fixes #10993
Clause-②: yes

Batch 4 of the family card, the closing batch. The `I18nLabel` positions the card's earlier batches taught the renderers to resolve now accept the per-locale map on `@object-ui/types`' faces too: `RecordDetailsComponentProps.sections[].label`, `RecordRelatedListComponentProps.title` and `.add.label`, and `RecordPathComponentProps.stages[].label` (item 1), and `ObjectGridSchema.title` on the interface and in the zod mirror (item 2). The parity test's cross-file line addresses are re-addressed by content (item 3). The census was re-taken on the installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0: it found two members the 17.4.0 census could not see, one of which (`record:related_list` `columns[].label`) drew a blank header for a map, and that one is repaired here. The closure note (item 4) is the last section. Draft: a dispatched dev's PR (claim comment 5933074589, branch `claude/issue-10993-batch4-ts-face`), so ready and landing belong to the seat.

## What changed

- **`packages/types/src/record-components.ts`** (item 1): the four members are typed `I18nLabel`, the spec's own type imported from `@objectstack/spec/ui` (no local re-declaration). Each docblock names the render site that resolves the map.
- **`packages/types/src/objectql.ts`** and **`packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts`** (item 2): `ObjectGridSchema.title` only. The interface types it `I18nLabel`; the mirror takes `stripImportedDefaults(SpecI18nLabelSchema)` by reference, as batch 1 did for `object-form`. Both comments quoted `ObjectGrid`'s read as `viewLabel: schema.label || schema.title`, which batch 3 replaced; they now describe the two `resolveInlineI18nLabel` reads. No other `ObjectGridSchema` key and no public-block arm is touched. Because an `object-view`'s `table` slot takes this key (`ObjectGridSlotKey`, and the zod slot rebuilt from the grid's `.shape`), `table.title` accepts the map on both faces too. `ObjectView` hands it to its grid, which resolves it; a new pin covers that path.
- **`apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts`** (item 3): every cross-file line address re-addressed by content: `sdui-parser`'s `validateTree`, `page.tsx`'s `getJsxManifest()`, the comment above the `record:activity` registration, the `ComponentRegistry.register('NAME', …)` calls for the four GA blocks and the five 17.1.0 record blocks, `OBJECT_KANBAN_INPUTS` / `OBJECT_CALENDAR_INPUTS`, and the `feed` member of the spec's `RecordChatterProps`. The release counted 13 such lines; the file carried 15 at base (the regex below), and all are gone. Prose and two exemption reason strings only; no assertion, row or cap moves.
- **`packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-related-list.tsx`** (the census repair, see "In-place repair" below): `localizeColumnLabels` resolves a column object's `label` map with `pickLocalized` against the UI language before the columns reach `RelatedList`, beside this block's `title` and `add.label`. The array is handed on by reference when no column carries a map.
- **`scripts/check-spec-symbol-derivation.mjs`**: `RecordDetailsComponentProps` and `RecordPathComponentProps` leave `CLAIM_DEBT`. Their spec-alignment claims became structural once the members referenced the spec's `I18nLabel`, and `check:spec-symbols` refused the stale entries; the block is the one `--claim-ledger` prints.
- **Pins**: `record-components-i18n-label-members-10993.test.ts` (types: each member equal to the same position of the installed spec's `z.input`, and to `I18nLabel`; the map compiles, a number is refused; the spec rows re-measured at runtime). `object-grid-title-mirrored.test.ts` re-judged: it pinned `title` as the plain `string`, which is the narrowing this batch removes, so its type assertion now reads `I18nLabel`, and it gains a map row, a non-string-entry row and an `object-view` `table.title` row beside the string and number rows that stand. `record-blocks.nestedLabelsI18nLabel-10993.test.tsx` (plugin-detail: `sections[].label`, `add.label` and `columns[].label` through the real `SchemaRenderer` under zh and en, string controls). `ObjectView.tableTitleI18nLabel-10993.test.tsx` (plugin-view: the registered `object-view` with the real `ObjectGrid`, caption under zh and en).
- **`.changeset/10993-batch4-ts-face.md`**: `@object-ui/types` minor (accepted sets widen), `@object-ui/plugin-detail` patch (the column-label repair), with the `Clause-②: yes` line.

No registration input moves. `object-grid.title` is one of that block's deliberately unregistered deprecated spellings (`plugin-grid/src/index.tsx`'s header note). The three nested members sit inside coarse inputs (`stages` and `sections` are `array` of `object`, `add` is `object`) whose kinds the widening does not change, and `record:related_list.title` already declares both arms (batch 2). So `MEMBER_PINS` gains no row and `packages/plugin-detail/src/index.tsx` is untouched.

### In-place repair: `record:related_list` `columns[].label`

Since `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0 (objectstack#18639) `ComponentPropsMap['record:related_list'].columns` declares the saved-view union, so a column may be a `ListColumn` object whose `label` is `I18nLabel`. Measured through the real `SchemaRenderer` before the repair: a string label became the header (`th` reads `Subject`), and a map drew a blank one (`th` reads the empty string under both zh and en), with no error. `RelatedList` turns `label` into the table's `header` through `core`'s `columnHeader`, which keeps a string only. Repaired under the bounded in-place rule: the same defect class as this card, a mechanical fix in the shape this renderer already uses for `title` and `add.label`, no open PR touching the file, and no new verification surface (this batch's type change already owes plugin-detail's type-check and suite). The seat amends the claim's file surface with this one file.

Not done here: adopting the column-object arm on `@object-ui/types`' `columns` (still `string[]`) and on the registration input (still `of: 'string'`, so `validateTree` reports `type-mismatch` on any column object, string-labelled or not). That is the saved-view-union adoption the maintainer ruled for the objectui half of objectstack#18639 ("9593 A"), not this family's.

## Premise checks (measured first, at base `2e060ba`)

- **Mechanism hypothesis 1, confirmed.** The four TS members were `string` at base. The installed spec (17.5.0) parses a locale map and refuses a number AT each member (`invalid_union` at `stages.0.label`, `sections.0.label`; map ok at `title` and `add.label`). The spec ships no liveness-ledger row for these component props (`liveness/*.json` cover metadata types, not `ComponentPropsMap`). Every renderer resolves the map: `record-path.tsx`'s `localizeStageLabels`, `record-details.tsx`'s `pickLocalized(rawTitleSrc, language)`, and `record-related-list.tsx`'s `pickLocalized(schema.title, …)` and `pickLocalized(schema.add.label, …)`, each read and render-pinned (the two batch 2 pins, and the new plugin-detail pin for the other two).
- **Mechanism hypothesis 2, confirmed in its widen branch.** The spec's `object-grid` row still declares `title: I18nLabelSchema.optional()`, described "Fallback for `label` (the renderer reads `label || title`)": not retired, not deprecated on the spec side. A map parses there and a number is refused at `title`. So both faces widen. objectui keeps its own `@deprecated Use label instead` marking (objectui#6639's declare-branch ruling); retiring the spelling is not this card's.
- **Mechanism hypothesis 3.** PR objectui#11184 is merged. The `OBJECTUI_11111_LEDGER_CAPS` were re-read rather than taken from the release, and they moved again during this run when objectui#11386 landed; they are read off the merged tree, never hand-merged. This PR moves none of them.
- **The public door.** A one-off probe (not committed) built the manifest from `ComponentRegistry.getPublicConfigs()` and ran `validateTree`: no diagnostic for a map at `record:path` `stages[].label`, `record:details` `sections[].label`, `record:related_list` `title` and `add.label`. The control, a number on `record:related_list.title`, draws `type-mismatch`. `object-grid.title` draws `unknown-prop` for a string and a map alike, which is the unregistered deprecated spelling, unchanged.

## Evidence

Final head `5d62bac` (after merging `main` at `8673402`) unless a line says otherwise. All runs through the shared verify lock on a shared box.

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/` plus the 17 console suites that import `register-plugins` (the parity test and the three I18nLabel manifest pins among them), the suites that name `check-spec-symbol-derivation`, `core`'s `column-identity.ratchet`, `cli`'s `check-schema-marker`, schema-catalog's `catalog-gallery-render`, the plugin-grid `title` and `label` pins, the plugin-detail I18nLabel pins and `RecordRelatedListRenderer` suites, and the plugin-view pin with `ObjectView.tableSlotRelay-10976`: `Test Files 378 passed (378)`, `Tests 9701 passed (9701)`.
- `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/plugin-view^...'` (15 tasks), then `type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && … tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) for `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, `@object-ui/plugin-grid` and `@object-ui/plugin-view`: each exit 0. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists the new pins in each package.
- Whole-package suites before the last `main` merge, at `53c796d`: `packages/plugin-detail/`, `Test Files 229 passed | 1 skipped (230)`; `packages/plugin-view/`, `Test Files 64 passed (64)`.
- **Consumer reverse leg** on the rebuilt `packages/types/dist`: a probe in plugin-detail assigning a map to `RecordRelatedListComponentProps.title` and to `ObjectGridSchema.title` compiles, and the same file's `title: 42` is the only error (TS2322 naming the `I18nLabel` union). Deleted after.
- **Red on base, types faces** (committed first; the three `packages/types` sources replaced by their base blobs under a trap; on-disk hashes equal the base blobs; markers 4/1 to 0/0): vitest `2 failed | 17 passed` (the `title` map row and the `object-view` slot row; the string, number and non-string-entry controls green), and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` 14 errors (12 in the new pin: 8 TS2344 on the two assertion tuples, 4 TS2322 on the map literals; 2 TS2344 in `object-grid-title-mirrored`). Restored: hashes equal the HEAD blobs, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Red on base, column repair** (`record-related-list.tsx` at its base blob, same discipline; `localizeColumnLabels` 3 to 0): `2 failed | 7 passed`, `expected [ '' ] to deeply equal [ '主题' ]` and the en twin; every control green. Restored by hash. This single-file leg ran outside the lock after the queue timed out twice (declared below).
- **Ablations** (objectstack `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor hit once, blob changed, restore proven each leg; the pins resolve `src` through the vitest alias, so no `dist` sits between mutation and run): `record-details.tsx`'s section `pickLocalized` read raw gives `2 failed | 4 passed`; `record-related-list.tsx`'s `add.label` read raw gives `2 failed | 4 passed`; `ObjectGrid.tsx`'s caption `title` read raw makes the `object-view` pin `2 failed | 1 passed`. Every red is "Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {en, zh-CN})". Direction observed: the normal one.
- Gates at `5d62bac`, each exit 0: `check:spec-symbols`, `check:component-surface-parity`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes`, `changeset:check`, `check:changeset-claims` (the 38 pending changesets naming a touched file were read; none is made false by this diff), `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:registry-bare-names`, `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-fences`, `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`. `check-governed-queue-guard --test` over the 11 paths: NOT GOVERNED.
- ESLint, narrowed and proven: the population is the config's own `files` blocks; `--format json --no-inline-config` over the 10 changed code files reports 10 files, 0 errors, 53 warnings, every one pre-existing (`record-related-list.tsx` 17, `objectql.ts` 35, `objectql.zod.ts` 1, equal to the `main` blobs; the other seven files 0). The config enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions`, `projectService` or `TypeChecked`), and no rule in `eslint-rules/` reads another file, so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.
- Cross-file line addresses in the parity test: `grep -nP` for the census's spellings (`NAME.ext:NNN`, the bare continuation `:NNN`, `#LNNN`, `line NNN`) reads 15 lines at base and 0 at this head.

## Acceptance notes

- **NOT MEASURED: `apps/console` type-check.** Reason: its dependency closure was not built here; the console change is comment prose in one test file. CI's type-check is the reading.
- **NOT MEASURED: the whole plugin-detail and plugin-view suites on the final head.** Reason: they were read at `53c796d`; the two `main` merges after it touch no file of this diff, and on the final head the plugin-detail and plugin-view suites that read this diff ran (listed above).
- **NOT MEASURED: `check:eager-closure` / Bundle Analysis, `check:doc-snippets`, `check:doc-examples`.** Reason: they need a full console build or the full package set; this diff adds no registration, no fenced snippet and no doc page.
- **Toolchain.** The container's node is 22.22.0 and `jsdom@30.0.1` declares `^22.22.2`, so the worktree install ran with `--config.engine-strict=false`; no repository file changed.
- **`RecordPathComponentProps.stages` stays required** where the spec row makes it optional, and `record-path.tsx` reads it through `unknown` for that reason (its own comment says so). A different narrowing, not an `I18nLabel` member; not touched.
- **Two pending changesets read narrower than the tree, neither because of this diff.** `fix-parity-aria-line-ref.md` (empty frontmatter, so it publishes nothing) says the parity test's `aria` reference now points at a line of `plugin-detail/src/index.tsx`; that address had drifted before this branch, and this branch replaces it with a content anchor. `10993-batch2-i18nlabel-reads.md` says `object-grid`'s deprecated `title` "still renders a map raw"; batch 3 made that false. Both are other PRs' changesets and are not edited here.
- **`main` moved twice during the run** and was merged twice by merge commit (`47af25e`, `5d62bac`): objectui#11384 and objectui#11385, then objectui#11386 and objectui#11387. objectui#11384 edits other regions of `objectql.ts` / `objectql.zod.ts` and merged clean; objectui#11386 edits the parity test (it judges `object-gantt`) and merged clean, and the re-addressed prose survived it. The tests and gates above were re-run on the merged head.

Rows this batch did not touch carry PR objectui#11099's readings; nothing in this PR re-derives the table.

With the column-label repair, every row is repaired, resolving, or the deliberately unregistered `ai:chat_window`.
